ground_truth.title: Help picking a Full size hot-swap keyboard
ground_truth.author: cubethethird
with: I would check out the Zoom98. Your local vendor is Mech.land, so that would be the place with the cheapest shipping to you.
Qwertykeys also has the very affordable QK100 that has received it’s fair share of praise for it’s price:
I can’t really speak for the boards, but am very satisfied with Switches and some of their older Cherry Profile Doubleshots
I don’t think the QK100 is full size either. Again, they’ve scrunched up the nav cluster and removed keys.
